name: w8a8_block_int8_matmul
description: Blockwise W8A8 int8 GEMM with per-block scales. A is int8 [M,K], B is int8 [N,K], As is float32 [M, ceil(K/block_k)], Bs is float32 [ceil(N/block_n), ceil(K/block_k)], and block_size = (block_n, block_k). For each K block, accumulate the int32 dot A[:,k] @ B[:,k].T, convert to float32, multiply by the per-row As and per-N-block Bs scales, and sum across K blocks. The result is cast to output_dtype. Returns a newly allocated [M,N] tensor and does not mutate inputs. Suites exercise int8 operands, float32 scales, block_size=[128,128] and bfloat16 output.
